description: I. draws 64×64 eyes with human expressions. A small cVAE-GAN generates each image. The full program — inference code and compressed weights — lives in 24 data contracts on Ethereum, locked forever. Your browser reads the program from Ethereum and runs it. No server and no outside library is needed.
